answer: We model a decentralized protocol where every node ingress at a network inlet locks staking collateral inside dynamic opportunity-cost bonds backed by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. Under a subgame-perfect slashing matrix with detection probability p, an adversary instantiating k Sybil identities yields expected payoff E[U] = k(pi - pS) < 0, as penalty S dwarfs gain pi. Anchored to an immutable shale state, this barrier turns attack profitability into a mathematical fable, guaranteeing strict Nash equilibrium convergence.
